public_rationale: The [launch disclosure](https://investor.salesforce.com/news/news-details/2024/Salesforce-Unveils-AgentforceWhat-AI-Was-Meant-to-Be/default.aspx) describes more than database retrieval: it includes planning and execution through existing automation tools. That weighs against the reduction to a chatbot interface. But it does not establish a measured difference from earlier chatbots, and several capabilities were forthcoming. The available comparison does not settle the claim.
limitations: Vendor descriptions establish the proposed design, not its reliability.
An LLM-driven planner can coexist with substantial reuse of earlier chatbot and workflow infrastructure.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Salesforce's Agentforce agents are essentially the same database-connected chatbots seen before, now connected to an LLM.

statement.excerpt: It doesn't really matter that these agents are basically the same "chatbot-that-connects-to-large-database-of-information" thing we’ve seen a million times, but this time connected to a Large Language Model.

from_speaker: but this time connected to a Large Language Model
our_interpretation: The target is Agentforce as presented at publication, including its announced design and contemporary pilots.
The plain reading is that adding an LLM did not materially change the capabilities of earlier database-connected chatbots. Merely having a conversational interface would not establish this.
For this ongoing product description, I use the September 2024 announcement cycle through the post date as the latest publicly reportable period.
A comparison must establish what the earlier chatbots could do; I do not assume that they only retrieved information.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous specifications or reproducible comparisons show that Agentforce's substantive capabilities matched earlier database-connected chatbots, with the LLM chiefly changing the conversational interface.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous evidence establishes materially different capabilities, such as dynamically selecting and executing task sequences beyond the earlier systems' capabilities.

evidence.locator: Zoom In & How it Works — Salesforce Platform Innovation — AI
evidence.explanation: Salesforce described retrieval plus planning, existing automation integrations, and conversational pilot use. The disclosure also placed general availability after the post and some Atlas components in 2025, so it does not establish the full September capability difference.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Archived September pilot documentation or demonstrations comparing Agentforce with an identified earlier chatbot on the same tasks, with clear feature availability and execution records.
